help.intro: Answers to common questions and direct ways to reach us.
help.faq_content:
# Frequently asked

## How do I invite my partner?

From Profile, go to Invite partner. Inviting requires an active Pro subscription. The link is valid for 7 days.

## What happens when my subscription expires?

You keep read + write access to all your data, plus a one-time full export. Partner sharing is preserved.

## How do I delete my project?

From Profile → Danger zone. The action is irreversible.

## Who sees my expenses?

Only you and your invited partner. The data is encrypted at rest and RLS blocks unauthorised access.
help.changelog_content:
# What's new

## Version 1.0 (Sprint 0)

The first MVP build: phone-OTP sign-in, project creation, partner invites, expenses, documents, tasks, couple surveys, and professionals.

## What's next?

We're working on what you ask for — drop us a line from this page.

legal.terms_content:
# Terms of Service

Initial draft — requires legal review before public launch.

## Data we collect

HaBoneh stores the data you enter: first name, phone number, project details, expenses, documents, tasks, and AI-chat messages. Storage is on Supabase EU.

## Cross-border transfer

Third-party services we use (Supabase, RevenueCat, Sentry, Google Gemini AI) operate outside Israel. By continuing to use the app you consent to cross-border data transfer for service delivery.

## Privacy Protection Amendment 13

We comply with Amendment 13. You have rights of access, correction, and deletion. Contact us at support@haboneh.app.

## Retention

Project data is retained while the account is active. After account deletion — 30 days until full removal. System logs without PII — up to 12 months.

## Cancellation under Consumer Protection 51

You can cancel your subscription anytime from Profile → Subscription inside the app. Written confirmation arrives within 24 hours. No need to contact Apple/Google.

## AI advisory disclaimer

The AI chat is general guidance, not professional advice. For construction, legal, regulatory, financial, or medical decisions consult a licensed professional.

## Two-seat data sharing

When you invite a partner, they see all project data. Both seat holders have equal read + write rights.
legal.privacy_content:
# Privacy Policy

Initial draft — requires legal review before public launch.

## What we collect

First name, phone number (verification only), the project data you enter, narrow analytics events (PostHog), and crash reports (Sentry) — neither contains PII.

## How we use it

To deliver the app, sync between the two partners, debug, and improve. Never sold to third parties for advertising.

## Cookies + identifiers

No cookies. An anonymous device identifier for analytics only.

## Your rights

- Access: see all your data inside the app.
- Correct: edit inline.
- Delete: Profile → Danger zone → Delete account, or write to us.

## Contact

support@haboneh.app
